title: Create chatbot/memory/search.py
description:
Create chatbot/memory/search.py — the searchable conversation history module.

Implement search logic over stored memories and conversation turns: full-text or semantic search with date range filtering, topic/tag filtering, and pagination. Return results with provenance metadata when available. Optimize queries for Postgres (not in-memory scanning). The search interface should compose with existing memory and turn storage backends.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/db/models.py for the memory and turn model schemas
- chatbot/memory/ (any existing modules) for query patterns

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/memory/search.py exists and is a valid Python module
Module exports a search function with date range, topic, and pagination parameters
Search queries run against Postgres (not in-memory)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

forbidden: introduce new search framework like Elasticsearch or Meilisearch
